title: Harness — *Cockpit*
dek: This one is done being useful for now. Building more of it is how the sprint dies.

sections.heading: where this *stands*
sections.body:
The system-building thread has been quiet for nearly two weeks and that is the right outcome, not a problem — the last real work here closed with your own verdict of good and the sprint does not need more machinery.

Stage: build — files are moving; nothing finalized. In the last 14 days: 2 assets generated.

Handoff status is active. Last activity 13d ago.

Next: Leave this parked and touch it only when a specific sprint task hits friction you can name in one sentence.

sections.heading: the state, as the last session *left* it
sections.body:
Assessment: Two of the four missions on this board are marked as superseded by the offer lock, which tells the story: this thread kept generating candidate businesses until the actual offer decision made that work unnecessary. What survived is the operator routine and the daily rhythm layer, which are now infrastructure rather than projects. Idle here is healthy. The only risk is drift back into building, which is the most comfortable way to avoid selling.

Handoff written 1d ago — treat its plan as current.

sections.heading: what needs *you*
sections.dek: The first option is the recommended one; the rest are the real alternatives with the tradeoff each carries.

items.action: Formally park until the sprint produces collected money
items.why: Recommended. Removes the most seductive avoidance path in the portfolio. Costs nothing real — the working parts already run without attention.

items.action: Spend one bounded session clearing the degraded lanes and drift warnings flagged at startup
items.why: Buys a quieter working environment and removes low-grade friction, but it is maintenance dressed as progress and it competes with sending.
No recorded activity in 13 days while the handoff is still active. Park keeps it resumable and quiet; kill hides it for good (ledger-recoverable).

plays.title: Resume here
plays.receipt: The stored handoff prints with drift since it was written.

plays.title: Park it
plays.intent: Shelve deliberately — resumable, muted, never urgent.
plays.receipt: Handoff annotated parked; drops out of needs-you.

plays.title: Kill it
plays.intent: Dead + hidden. Never resurfaces on boards or in the sweep; recoverable only from the ledger.

action.name: kill
action.confirm: Kill this thread? It disappears from every board.

sections.body:
